entities.name: Leighbet
entities.description: A former Izzet inventor who discovered a way of making subjects impervious to electricity and was transformed by a Simic experiment.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Ravnican guild from which Leighbet lost her position.

entities.name: Tamsyn Sweene
entities.description: A blast-seeker who was a Dimir shapeshifter; murdered the test subjects and was killed by Leighbet.

entities.name: Simic Crucible
entities.description: Simic laboratory where Leighbet underwent experiments.

events.summary: Leighbet loses her Izzet position after a daring experiment goes wrong and sets up an unsanctioned lab.
events.quote: the loss of her position within the Izzet League

events.summary: Leighbet recruits Tamsyn Sweene to assist her experiments.
They discover rift-tainted magic that makes subjects impervious to electricity; Tamsyn murders the test subjects.
events.quote: by that time, Tamsyn had already murdered them

events.summary: Leighbet undergoes Simic experiments and is turned into a human-monster hybrid.
events.quote: turned her into a hybrid creature, part human and part-monster

events.summary: Tamsyn is revealed as a Dimir shapeshifter who manipulated Leighbet; Leighbet kills her in the sewers.
events.quote: confront and ultimately kill Tamsyn in a battle within the sewer environment

events.summary: Leighbet returns to her laboratory, vowing to protect her discoveries.
events.quote: She returned to her laboratory with a renewed sense of purpose
